name: POWERbunker / RZKH GmbH Rechenzentrum Kreuznach
notes: Operator contact page places Rechenzentrum Kreuznach at Scholländer Weg 10, 55595 Weinsheim; POWERbunker pages describe IBM i hosting in a hardened underground shelter and say the operator runs two data centres on its premises.

name: CyberBunker Traben-Trarbach
notes: Former NATO bunker in Traben-Trarbach operated as a bulletproof-hosting data center until police shut it down in September 2019; source reports hundreds of servers and law-enforcement action.

name: Bunker Erwin high-security data center, Börfink
notes: Rhein-Zeitung reported ITVT's high-performance data center in the former Bundeswehr Bunker Erwin went live around 2014-12-31 with about 10 PB of storage and fiber links to Frankfurt; ITVT's 2025 page says it still operates a climate-friendly data center on the site.

name: Hochschule Trier Rechenzentrum Umwelt-Campus Birkenfeld
notes: Official Hochschule Trier pages list the Rechenzentrum Umwelt-Campus as a university data center/service unit at Campusallee, Hoppstädten-Weiersbach, responsible for campus IT infrastructure, networks, physical and virtual servers, and external connections.

name: Unnamed Rechenzentrum in Kirchheimbolanden
notes: A refrigeration/HVAC contractor reference page identifies outdoor units for a data center in Kirchheimbolanden; no operator, capacity, or project name was found in public search results.

name: LCSasp ASP Rechenzentrum Frankenthal
notes: LCS official service page states its ASP data center in Frankenthal supports outsourced customer servers with backup, high availability, resiliency, and data security.
